_comment: Pattern list used by `paper_tools.py polish scan`. Advisory only: a hit means 'look at this sentence', not 'this is wrong'. Researcher-editable: add, delete or loosen rules to match your own field and voice. Fields: id, lang (zh|en|any), category, regex, hint; needs_evidence=true flags the sentence only when it carries no number, {{res:id}} or table/figure reference; needs_evidence="cite" flags it only when it carries no [@key].

rules.regex: 近年来|随着[^，。]{1,24}(的)?(快速|迅速|不断|持续|深入)?(发展|推进|深化|普及)
rules.hint: 删去时代背景套话，直接写本文要回答的问题和缺口

rules.regex: (引起|引发|受到)了?(学界|社会|各界|政府)?的?(广泛|高度|普遍)关注
rules.hint: 说明谁在争论什么，用具体文献代替“受到关注”

rules.regex: (具有|有着)(重要的|重大的|深远的)?(理论|现实)(意义|价值)
rules.hint: 写出对哪条文献争论或哪项政策判断有什么增量

rules.regex: 值得注意的是|需要指出的是|值得一提的是|不难发现|显而易见|毋庸置疑
rules.hint: 重要的内容让句子本身说明，删掉提示语

rules.regex: 综上所述|总而言之|总的来说
rules.hint: 直接写结论并指向证据（表、图或结果编号）
拆成两句，或写出两者的具体关系

rules.regex: 开创性|里程碑|革命性|颠覆性|前所未有|填补了?(国内|学术|研究)?空白|首次|率先|创新性地
rules.hint: 写出与哪些文献相比差在哪里；“首次”须有文献依据

rules.regex: 学界普遍认为|大量(的)?研究(表明|证明|发现|显示)|众所周知|已有研究(普遍)?(表明|认为|发现)|现有文献(普遍)?(表明|认为)
rules.hint: 改成具体 [@key]，并说明该文献的结论与适用条件

rules.regex: 证明了?|证实了?|彻底|根本性地?|毫无疑问|必然(会|导致|使)
rules.hint: 实证结果用“表明”“提供证据”；除非有定理，不用“证明”

rules.regex: 显著
rules.hint: 同时给出经济量级与统计精度，或链接结果 {{res:id}}

rules.regex: 较为|相对而言|(在)?一定程度上|某种程度上
rules.hint: 量化（给出区间并说明口径），或直接删去

rules.regex: (大量|广泛|深入|全面|系统)(的)?(实验|检验|分析|研究|稳健性检验)
rules.hint: 写出具体检验的数量与种类

rules.regex: [Ii]n recent years|[Ww]ith the rapid (development|growth|expansion) of|has attracted (increasing|growing) attention
rules.hint: Open with the question and the gap, not the era

rules.regex: \b(delve[sd]?|delving|underscor(e|es|ed|ing)|intricate|tapestry|testament|pivotal|showcas(e|es|ed|ing)|seamless(ly)?|realm|paves? the way)\b
rules.hint: Use the plain word or state the concrete point

rules.regex: \bleverag(e|es|ed|ing)\b
rules.hint: Usually 'use'

rules.regex: to the best of our knowledge|for the first time|\bnovel\b|groundbreaking|revolutioni[sz]e
rules.hint: Say what prior work does not do, with citations

rules.regex: [Ii]t is worth noting that|[Ii]t should be (noted|emphasi[sz]ed) that|\b[Nn]otably,|\b[Ii]mportantly,
rules.hint: If it matters, the sentence shows it

rules.regex: \b(prove[sd]?|proving)\b|\bdemonstrate[sd]? that\b|\bconfirm(s|ed)? that\b
rules.hint: Empirical work shows or provides evidence; it does not prove

rules.regex: \bsignificantly\b
rules.hint: Give the magnitude and the precision, or link {{res:id}}

rules.regex: \b(somewhat|relatively|fairly|to some extent|quite)\b
rules.hint: Quantify or cut

rules.regex: (extensive|comprehensive|thorough) (experiments|analysis|evaluation|robustness)|a wide range of
rules.hint: State how many and which

rules.regex: ^(依据|基于|根据|按照)[^，。]{1,16}(理论|框架|范式)
rules.hint: 让现象或问题先行，理论放到解释处

rules.regex: (此|该)(案例|结果|发现)(印证|挑战|揭示|说明)了|这提示我们|由此可见|从中可以看出
rules.hint: 删去段末的点题句，让下一句承接论证

rules.regex: (该|上述)(处理|设计|决策|选择|方法)(体现|反映|印证)了
rules.hint: 写清为什么这样做，以及依据是什么

rules.regex: (面临的)?核心(问题|挑战)(是|在于)|主要矛盾体现在
rules.hint: 用具体的矛盾或数据把问题摆出来

rules.regex: 前景广阔|意义深远|具有深远影响|发挥着?(至关重要|重要)的作用
rules.hint: 写具体的政策含义或后续检验，不用笼统结尾

rules.regex: (本文|本研究)的?(主要)?(贡献|创新)(在于|主要有|体现在)
rules.hint: 贡献逐条写具体结果，与哪些文献相比增加了什么

rules.regex: (This|The) paper contributes to the literature|The remainder of this paper is organi[sz]ed as follows|[Ii]t is easy to show that|[Aa] comment is in order
rules.hint: Say what is found; give a roadmap specific to this paper

rules.regex: \bWe (investigate|examine|explore) the relationship between\b
rules.hint: State the finding, not the activity

rules.regex: \b(utili[sz]e[sd]?|utili[sz]ing)\b
rules.hint: Use 'use'
